`enum UIStoreScope`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.ui.core.hook.store` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [UIStoreScope.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/ui/core/hook/store/UIStoreScope.java)

How long a store lives and which UIs share it.

## Learn more

- [Stores and properties](/use/learn/state/stores-and-properties/#choose-where-a-value-lives)
- [Build a settings screen](/use/guides/build-a-settings-screen/)

<a id="UIStoreScope-methods"></a>

## Methods

| Returns | Signature | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `boolean` | [isLocal](#UIStoreScope-method-isLocal)() | If `true`, each UI gets its own store. |
| `boolean` | [isGlobal](#UIStoreScope-method-isGlobal)() | If `true`, the store is shared by every UI. |

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`LOCAL`](#UIStoreScope-value-LOCAL) | Each UI that asks for the store gets its own, destroyed when that UI closes. |
| [`GLOBAL`](#UIStoreScope-value-GLOBAL) | One store for the whole application, shared by every UI, kept in memory until the program ends. |
| [`PERMANENT`](#UIStoreScope-value-PERMANENT) | Like `GLOBAL`, and saved in the data folder so that its values come back at the next run. |
